text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, morning, Trainer!
Thanks for the vacation, I had a ton of fun!
choice_data_list: Did you go somewhere or something?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I went to a dog park! There were sooo many different dogs, and they were all running around soo much!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Do you know what an English Greyhound is?
They're super fast dogs!
I even raced against one!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to race them again~.
It's great training, too. I wish they'd come join the academy...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's go negotiate with the academy!
The voice of destiny says that's the way to go too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her wish didn't seem to come true, but Epiphaneia appeared to have had a fulfilling day nevertheless.
